item.tib: tshe dbang drag khros kyi skong ba
item.coloph: de ltar dz+wa this drag po'i bskang (skong) bshags 'di/ phyi rabs don du tshe dbang bdag gis bgyis/ dam ldan gshen po rnams kyis nyams su longs/ dam nyams ru tra'i sde la gsang rgya sdoms/ g.yung drung gsal 'bar la sogs gshen rnams la/ bka' 'di gtad do yid la dam du bzung (zungs) / dus mthar bon chos bstan pa dar nub skabs/ bA+ai ro la sogs rig 'dzin du ma yi/ lo tsa mkhas pa'i brda' ris bris nas su/ zhang zhung sgo mo gnas kyi nye ba'i char/ byang nub zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas kyi tshab/ brag dmar rin chen 'bar ba'i g.yon zur gyi/ tsi ta 'dra ba'i brag la gter du sbas so/ sgra bla'i rgyal mo bya ra ma gsum dang*/ rdo rje dgra 'dul sogs kyi (kyis) bka' 'di srung (srungs)/ phyis su rten 'brel rnam pa lnga shar tshe/ nges med sprul sku gcig gis rnyed par shog/
